purpose: A key released 0.3 ms after the tone key, while the tone key's edit is in flight. Before ADR 0322 the tap held that keyUp and the worker replayed a rebuilt one; in a WKWebView field the next press of the same key was then lost (Pa's dev traces of 14 and 15/11/2026: 'dù mục' typed as 'dù mc'). With the fix the keyUp passes and nothing is lost.

testOnlyRule.why: Widens the in-flight window of the tone key's edit so the 0.3 ms release lands inside it on any machine.

events.source: CGEventSource(stateID: .hidSystemState), posted at .cghidEventTap, userData 0 (hardware-like, never the app's marker)
events.unit: microseconds from the start of the trial

expect.field: the per-trial text 50 times, read back through AX after the last trial

variants.name: build before ADR 0322 (red run)
variants.expect: losses in the web fields, none in the native control

variants.name: ApplePressAndHoldEnabled NO for TestHost
variants.expect: recorded for ADR 0322: does press-and-hold matter

variants.name: a letter without accents: the 'h' of 'minhf' released 0.3 ms after the 'f', then 'nhaajn'
